newsitem.title: USA: Double Day signs 11-yr Mon View deal.
newsitem.headline: Double Day signs 11-yr Mon View deal.

text.p: Double Day Inc said on Wednesday it signed a $140 million reclamation contract with Mon View Mining Corp of Uniontown, Pa., to remediate a waste coal fines pond in Washington County, Pa.
Double Day's Diversified Resources International Ltd unit will dredge the pond and build a plant to clean the fines and prepare them for sale. The contract is for 11 years.
Double Day recycles non-hazardous industrial wastes and by-products.
